correctness.rationale: Theorem 43 of Dilworth–Kutzarova–Ostrovskii explicitly gives uniqueness of the automorphism-invariant cycle projection for any Hamming alphabet; finite signed edge-permutation averaging then minimizes P for every ℓp and similarly its complement Q. The cut projection column Dᵀ L†b factors via the K_q eigenvector h and a radial Green kernel f=(qI+L_H(d-1,q))^-1 δ0 with integral formula. Its strictly decreasing radial coefficients enable the exact ℓ1 absolute sum of 2(q-1)/q for first-coordinate edges and (d-1)(q-1)/q for other directions. Transitivity/rank gives Q_ee=2(1-q^-d)/(d(q-1)), hence ||P||_1=1+||Q||_1-2Q_ee. Symmetry gives equal ℓ∞ norms. Independently built graph Laplacian pseudoinverses for H(2,2), H(2,3), H(2,4), H(3,3), H(3,4); both formulas match. The verification is bounded, but the integral/telescoping proof covers all d,q. Binary q=2 is acknowledged prior art.
residual_risks: Only q≥3 is claimed new, q=2 is prior work; p endpoints 1/∞ explicit, interior minimality only.
